title: Chart quiz #14
caption:
Chart quiz #14. No peeking at the reveal.

Q1: Continue, or reverse?
Q2: Gap fill, or gap and go?
Q3: Where does the stop go?

Each chart pauses so you can comment your answer, then plays on to show what happened, and why.

Tell me your score: 0, 1, 2 or 3?

Practise reading charts at memestreet.net

Fictional market. Not investment advice.

#MemeStreet #ChartQuiz #BullFlag #Earnings #LearnToTrade
narration: Three charts. Three new skills to test. Flags, gaps and stops. Question one. A sharp rally, then a quiet drift lower on light volume. Does the move continue, or reverse? It continued. That's a bull flag. A strong pole, then a calm pause on fading volume, before the next leg up. Question two. Earnings came out, and the stock gapped up. Will the gap fill, or will it gap and go? It filled. Volume faded after the open, and long upper wicks showed sellers waiting above. Gaps on strong, rising volume are more likely to keep going. Question three. You just bought this bounce off support. Where does the stop go? A, B, or C? C, just below the swing low. B gets hit by an ordinary dip, and A risks far too much. Below the swing low is where your idea is proven wrong. How many did you get? Tell me your score in the comments. Practise on real charts from the game, at memestreet.net.
